name: NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand Platform Datasheet
notes: Quantum-2: 64 400Gb/s ports or 128 200Gb/s ports per switch, 51.2 Tb/s bidirectional throughput, 66.5B packets/sec, SHARPv3, MPI tag matching, MPI AlltoAll acceleration, adaptive routing, congestion control, self-healing networking. ConnectX-7 adapter with PCIe Gen5.
